script.onScreen: Small acts of kindness matter. / A hadith, with context.
REFLECTION / The context / These words were addressed to A'isha. Kindness is not weakness: it is a quality Allah loves and rewards. It applies to how we correct, ask and disagree.
IN PRACTICE / Correct in private · Ask, don't order · Be patient with the slow
Choose the gentle way. / Save this reminder

caption:
Small acts of kindness deserve our attention, too.

Sahih Muslim 2593: Allah is kind and loves kindness.

Swipe for the context and three practical examples.

Save this reminder.

📖 Sources
• Sahih Muslim 2593 (Sahih, tr. Abdul Hamid Siddiqui) — sunnah.com/muslim:2593
Full text: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:'A'isha, verily Allah is kind and He loves kindness and confers upon kindness which he does not confer upon severity and does not confer upon anything else besides it (kindness)
